conclusions: Both target mean and P10 fail the fixed original fine4square comparison in all8 cases under skin_contact_only caps; no adoption.
Skin/contact-capped mean and P10 ranking changes from coarse16,8,4,12 to fine4,8,12,16.
Physical areas and metal-node topology remain unchanged across each mesh pair; numerical tissue-face sharing differs.
Coarse8 and16 each share44 tissue top faces across4 same-electrical-node pad pairs, zero different-node pairs; fine has no shared top faces. This is not evidence of metal merging or a short.
Raw contact voltage maxima and hotspot patch fractions change with grid; this establishes mesh/fragment sensitivity, not a proven nonphysical artifact or converged edge maximum.
